market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-volatile. Oil near $100 and US-Iran conflict create upside risk to inflation and downside risk to equities. Yen carry trade positioning is a flashpoint. S&P 500 short interest at decade highs suggests potential sharp two-way moves. Dow already down 300 points on the session. Energy outperforms; tech resilient but vulnerable to risk-off. Expect 5-8% equity volatility over next 4-6 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive for selective sectors. AI/semiconductor capex cycle remains multi-year structural trend. China capital market opening and bond deepening offer 12-month alpha. Energy transition and infrastructure spending (GE, Vistry, energy security) provide secular tailwinds. However, trade war fragmentation and Social Security fiscal risk create structural headwinds. 6-12 month equity outlook: +5-10% for quality/growth, flat for broad market.
